free.label: REFLUX FREE v1.0.21
free.message: Thermals & Cool Mode — live CPU/GPU temps on detailed chip and graphics-card SVGs. FREE includes Light Cool Mode for 10 minutes (Chill/Balanced are PRO). Tutorial arrows fixed. Sidebar shows your Windows display name and version (24H2 / 25H2).

pro.label: REFLUX PRO v1.0.30
pro.message: Thermals & Cool Mode — live CPU/GPU temps on detailed chip and graphics-card SVGs, plus interactive Cool Mode to drop heat. Tutorial arrows now point at the button. Sidebar shows your Windows display name and version (24H2 / 25H2).
